html:
Question 11
?

Given the sphere x2+(y+3)2+(z−1)2=2, what is the domain of z=z(x,y)?

a
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius 2 centered at (0,3)
b
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius 2 centered at (0,−3)
c
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius 4 centered at (3,0)
d
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius 2 centered at (−3,0)
e
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius 2 centered at (0,−3)
